data.desc: Fortuna Mining Corp. is a Canadian precious metals mining company with three operating mines, the feasibility-stage Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal, and a portfolio of exploration projects in Argentina, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea, Guyana, and Peru. Fortuna is targeting an annualized production rate of approximately 500,000 gold equivalent ounces from the second half of 2028. Sustainability is at the core of our operations and stakeholder relationships. We produce gold and silver while creating long-term shared value through efficient production, environmental stewardship, and social responsibility. For more information, please visit our website at www.fortunamining.
